## Progress

- Open [PR #55](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/55): Scheduling module (own schema, module role, EF filters + RLS) — weekly template per doctor or resource (sessions with room, breaks, slot length, per-visit-type lengths), slots generated on the fly in the facility zone (IST, GST and DST unit tests), P-04 day view with hatched unavailable time and reason, role checked against the membership at the facility, audited endpoints; mutation-checked; browser-verified (en, ar RTL, axe)
- Left: listing appointments outside new hours and spanning visits on the grid (MDV-P1-021); template editing UI in Settings → Hours (MDV-P1-005)

## Description

Per doctor and location: weekly template (weekday, start, end, room/resource), breaks (e.g. lunch), default slot length (15/20/30 min) and per-visit-type length (e.g. new consult 40 min = 2 slots). Facility time zone; all times stored UTC and displayed in facility time. Resources (procedure room) can be scheduled like a doctor column. Generates bookable slots on the fly (no pre-materialised slot table required) or materialises slots per day — decision recorded.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a template Mon–Fri 09:00–13:00 and 17:00–20:00 with 20-minute slots, then the calendar shows bookable slots exactly in those windows in facility local time.
- [ ] **AC2.** Breaks and closed days show as Unavailable (hatched) with the reason and cannot be booked.
- [ ] **AC3.** Changing a template affects only future unbooked slots; existing appointments outside new hours are listed for action.
- [ ] **AC4.** Visit types can span multiple slots and the calendar renders them spanning.
- [ ] **AC5.** Daylight-saving-free zones (IST, GST) and a test zone with DST are handled correctly (unit tests).

## Definition of Done
